_comment: Whether each box has actually been produced, so collection tools count only what a player can realistically get. Checked 2026-08-10 against four catalogues: the publisher's own store (queti-tectonics.com), Gamers Guild AZ, Ignition Core Games and Tabletop Renaissance. The last three come from OTTO's stock watcher at E:\ClaudeProjects\EmberQuitiStock, which polls the real listings - `stock-state.json` there is the fastest way to refresh this file.
_why: The publisher's own store is not a reliable release signal on its own - it lists UN Core, Raid, Reaper Type E and both Vigilant kits as "Coming Soon" while retailers have carried all five, which means they exist and are simply awaiting restock. A retailer listing something as SOLD OUT is the strongest evidence of release: they had stock to sell. Conversely the entire GoF range appears in NO catalogue anywhere, so its cards are not obtainable at all even though our card data holds them.
_shape: boxes maps a box key to { released, product, seen, checked }, plus an optional hasImage when we have added a box cover the upstream data does not know about, and an optional hidden. `released` is the flag tools filter on: it means the box has been produced and sold somewhere. `hidden` is different and stronger - it drops the box from the Boxes tab and the inventory entirely, for something nobody can ever buy again. A hidden box keeps its cards and they still name it, so nothing is lost; it just stops padding the lists. `seen` records what each catalogue said, because stock changes weekly and provenance should not have to be re-derived.
_maintenance: Stock levels deliberately are NOT tracked - they change too fast to keep honest. Only `released` matters, and it only ever flips once. OTTO updates this as boxes are confirmed in hand.
_blindspot: These catalogues only see what is CURRENTLY sold, and they are searched by the name OUR data uses. Both failure modes have now bitten: White Dwarf was produced long enough ago to have fallen out of every listing, and Genji & Mallard was on the publisher's own store the whole time under a different name ("replacement set"), while Trial Octopus was only ever at a retailer. Three of the four boxes this file first called unreleased turned out to exist. So silence means "not found", never "not made" - ask OTTO rather than inferring, and search the product wording rather than the kit name.
_mercenaries: Do not read a faction's box count as its playability. PD and COLLABORATION are MERCENARY factions and may join an RDL, UN or GoF squad (see the faction-legality notes and MERCENARY_FACTIONS in units.ts), so GoF - which has exactly one box on sale - is still fieldable by pairing the Centaur SK with PD merc kits. Someone placed 4th in a tournament doing exactly that.

UN_CORE._note: The publisher calls it Coming Soon, but Gamers Guild AZ has carried it, so it exists.

COMBAT_RAID._note: Same pattern: publisher says Coming Soon, Ignition has carried it. OTTO expects a copy the week of 2026-08-10.

LAB_PD_CRISIS1._art: assets/box_cover/20.webp, taken from the product page on the publisher's store 2026-08-10 and trimmed to the art panel. boxes.json is regenerated from the builder bundle and does not know about art we add ourselves, so the flag has to live here.

LAB_GOF_CENTAUR._note: A GoF kit that IS on sale, unlike every GoF box.

LAB_PD_REAPER_TYPE_E._note: Listed by Ignition as the Reaper Engineer LAB Kit, so produced.

LAB_PD_Vigilant_Autocannon_MG._note: Tabletop Renaissance has carried it, so it exists despite the publisher calling it Coming Soon.

LAB_WHITE_DWARF._note: OTTO 2026-08-10: this WAS produced, long enough ago that no catalogue or tracker still has a record of it. A worked example of why absence from the shops is not proof of non-existence - the older a box is, the less the listings know. OTTO to reconfirm.

GOF_CORE._note: No GoF BOX appears in any catalogue. The faction's cards are in the v1.021 parts list but nothing containing them is sold. RECHECKED 2026-08-12 against ASIAN retailers after OTTO found an insert in the Dune box picturing all three GoF boxes with models: still nothing. HLJ (Japan) carries the line deep enough to have product codes for every released kit and lists no GoF; DiceHold (Korea) carries GOF-Centaur alone. A Korean community source states the faction is scheduled for a WINTER release, so the insert is a roadmap and its models are renders or pre-production.

LAB_RDL_GENJI_AND_MALLARD._note: OTTO 2026-08-10: released, on the publisher's own store at queti-tectonics.com/products/geji-mallard-replacement-set-4-in-1. The earlier sweep missed it because it is sold as a "replacement set" rather than under the kit name our data uses.

LAB_TRIAL_UN_OCTOPUS._note: Trial-model cards. OTTO 2026-08-10: released, carried by Ignition Core Games at ignitioncoregames.com/product-page/un-octopus-trial-model-lab-kit-ember-obsidian-protocol. Another case of the publisher's own store being the weakest signal.

GAME_PACK._note: Promotional/event cards rather than a retail box - most likely the Kickstarter pack. OTTO 2026-08-10: hidden, because nobody can buy it and listing it only pads the box count. HIDDEN IS NOT DELETED: its 7 cards stay in the data and still name it, so a card that came from here is still explained. Clear the flag if it ever returns.

UNSALE._note: Named for it: content the publisher does not sell. Already excluded everywhere.
